title: 校园事务词汇
goal: 能理解校园事务词汇并辨认手续和学业安排。

points.label: 听出校园安排及其限制条件

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲
sources.used: 课程内容依据的考试大纲

body.p: 校园事务涉及课程、作业、借阅和住宿。听手续类内容，先听清做什么、对什么做、什么时候截止。

body.box:
A: May I renew the book online?
B: Yes, unless another reader has requested it.

body.p: renew the book 表示续借。unless 后面是不能续借的情况：别的读者已经预约。

cards.title: 选课与考核
rows: take an elective; A: Is art required? B: No, it's an elective.
complete a required course; A: Must I take it? B: It's a required course.
enroll in a course; A: Are you in the class? B: I enrolled in it yesterday.
drop a course; A: Is Mina continuing? B: She dropped the course.
meet a prerequisite; A: Can I register now? B: First meet the prerequisite.
earn credits; A: What does the course award? B: Three credits.
continuous assessment; A: Is there a final test? B: No, assessment is continuous.
submit an assignment; A: What is due? B: The assignment.
receive a grade; A: Has the work been marked? B: Yes, the grade is online.
resit an exam; A: What if I fail? B: You may resit the exam.
cards.note: enroll in 指注册参加，drop 指退出已选课程。

cards.title: 研究与作业
rows: request an extension; A: Can I have more time? B: Request an extension.
meet a deadline; A: When is the deadline? B: Friday at noon.
cite a source; A: I used the article. B: Cite the source.
list references; A: Where are the sources? B: They're in the references.
revise a draft; A: Is this final? B: No, it's a draft.
prepare an outline; A: What comes before the draft? B: Prepare an outline.
consult a supervisor; A: Who advises the project? B: The supervisor.
receive feedback; A: What did the tutor send? B: Feedback on the draft.
submit a paper; A: Is the paper ready? B: Yes, I'll submit it.
revise a report; A: What will you do with the comments? B: Revise the report.
cards.note: request an extension 是申请延期。能否延期，看对方后面的答复。

cards.title: 图书借阅
rows: borrow a book; A: Can I take it home? B: Yes, borrow it at the desk.
renew a loan; A: Can I keep it longer? B: Renew the loan online.
return a book; A: Is the loan finished? B: Yes, return the book.
check the due date; A: When is it due? B: Check the due date.
an overdue book; A: Was it due yesterday? B: Yes, it's overdue.
reserve a book; A: It's on loan. B: Reserve it for later.
search the catalog; A: Where is the title listed? B: Search the catalog.
extend a loan period; A: How long may I keep it? B: The loan period is two weeks.
recall a book; A: Why return it early? B: The library recalled it.
pay a fine; A: What is the charge for? B: A fine for the late return.
cards.note: reserve 是预约，renew 是延长已有借期。

cards.title: 住宿与费用
rows: pay a deposit; A: What is paid before moving in? B: A deposit.
pay rent; A: What is due each month? B: The rent.
sign a lease; A: What records the rental terms? B: The lease.
apply for accommodation; A: Where will you live? B: I've applied for accommodation.
share with a roommate; A: Who shares the room? B: My roommate.
pay a utility bill; A: Is electricity included? B: No, pay the utility bill separately.
receive a refund; A: Was the extra payment returned? B: Yes, I received a refund.
pay a fee; A: Is the application free? B: No, there's a fee.
pay in installments; A: Must I pay all at once? B: No, installments are allowed.
move into a room; A: When can I enter the room? B: You can move in on Monday.
cards.note: deposit 是预付押金；refund 是退还的款项。

items.stem: Which term describes a course that students may choose but need not take?
options: A course with a prerequisite
An elective course
A course with continuous assessment
A required course
items.why: elective 指选修课，required course 是必修课。

items.stem: A student asks for an extension on a paper. What is requested?
options: More time before submission
More feedback after marking
A reference for the paper
A higher grade for the paper
items.why: extension 指延长期限。

items.stem: A library book is overdue. What is true about its due date?
options: It has been extended online.
It has been reserved for later.
It has already passed.
It has yet to be announced.
items.why: overdue 表示已过到期日。

items.stem: A tenant receives a refund of the deposit. What happens to the money?
options: It becomes the next month's rent.
It is paid as a new application fee.
It is divided into installments.
It is returned to the tenant.
items.why: refund 指退款，押金被退还给租住者。

items.stem: A professor asks for an outline before the draft. What should the student prepare first?
options: A plan of the paper's main points
A first full version of the paper
A list of feedback on the draft
The finished version of the paper
items.why: outline 指写作提纲，用于安排文章要点。

items.stem: A library recalls a book that is on loan. What does the library require?
options: Payment for a new reservation
The return of the borrowed book
A renewal of the current loan
A request for another loan period
items.why: recall a book 指召回已借出的书。

lines.text: I'd like to enroll in the statistics course, but I haven't completed the introductory class. Is there another way to meet the prerequisite?
Yes. You can take a placement test on Monday. If you pass, the department will allow you to enroll. Registration closes on Wednesday.

items.stem: What must the student do to enroll without the introductory class?
options: Pass the Monday placement test
Complete the class by Wednesday
Ask the department for permission first
Register before the Monday test
items.why: If you pass 后接 allow you to enroll，条件是通过周一的测试。

items.stem: When does registration close?
options: On Monday, after the test
When the department replies
On Wednesday, after the test
Before the test on Monday
items.why: Registration closes on Wednesday 给出注册截止时间。

lines.text: I'd like to renew the book about maps. Its due date is tomorrow, and I need it for a report. Can I renew it online?
Yes, as long as nobody else has reserved it. The catalog shows no reservation now, so you can renew it for another week.

items.stem: What condition applies to the renewal?
options: The report must be submitted tomorrow.
The book must have no other reservation.
The student must renew it before tomorrow.
The student must search the catalog first.
items.why: as long as nobody else has reserved it 是续借的条件。

items.stem: How much longer can the student keep the book?
options: Until tomorrow morning
For the rest of the report
Until another reader reserves it
For another week after renewing
items.why: renew it for another week 指续借一周。

lines.text: The housing office offered me a room starting in September. Is the deposit included in the first month's rent? I need to arrange the payment.
No, the deposit is separate. Pay it by Friday to keep the room. The first month's rent is due when you move in.

items.stem: What must the student pay by Friday to keep the room?
options: The first month's rent
The deposit and rent together
The deposit, paid separately
The full payment for the room
items.why: Pay it by Friday 中 it 指前句的 deposit。

items.stem: When is the first month's rent due?
options: When the student moves in
When the room offer arrives
On the deposit deadline
By Friday, with the deposit
items.why: The first month's rent is due when you move in 给出缴费时间。

items.stem: A student drops a course after enrolling. What has the student done?
options: Completed the course assessment
Withdrawn from the course
Earned credit for the course
Registered for the course again
items.why: drops a course 表示退掉已选课程。

items.stem: A tutor asks a student to cite a source in the report. What should the student add?
options: A note of where the information came from
A summary of the source's main argument
An extra draft of the research outline
A list of sources to read later
items.why: cite a source 指引用时注明信息出处。

items.stem: A reader renews a library loan. What changes?
options: The reader reserves a different book.
The reader pays a fine for late return.
The reader returns the book immediately.
The reader may keep the book longer.
items.why: renew a loan 表示续借，延长借用时间。

items.stem: A residence requires a deposit before a student moves in. What is required?
options: A monthly utility bill
The first month's rent
An advance security payment
A refund of the rent
items.why: deposit 是入住前支付的押金。

items.stem: A lecturer sends feedback on a draft. What has the student received?
options: A new deadline for the draft
Comments on work in progress
A grade for the final version
A list of references for the draft
items.why: feedback on a draft 是针对草稿的意见。

items.stem: A housing office allows rent to be paid in installments. What does this allow?
options: Payment in several separate amounts
A refund before the rent is paid
A lower deposit for the room
Payment only after the lease ends
items.why: pay in installments 指分期付款。

lines.text: I need the history book for my paper, but the catalog says it's on loan. Can I reserve it?
Yes, I'll place a reservation. We'll email you when it's returned. You then have two days to collect it; after that it goes to the next reader.

items.stem: What will the library employee do?
options: Extend the current reader's loan
Renew the book for the student
Cancel the next reader's request
Place a reservation for the book
items.why: I'll place a reservation 表示工作人员将预约这本书。

items.stem: What condition applies after the book is returned?
options: The student must renew it online.
The student must write the paper in two days.
The student has two days to collect it.
The student must wait for the next reader.
items.why: have two days to collect it 限定通知后的领取时间。

lines.text: My draft is due Friday, but I need more time to check the references. Can I request an extension?
Yes, submit the request today. If the tutor approves it, the new deadline will be next Tuesday. Until you receive approval, Friday remains the deadline.

items.stem: What must happen for the Tuesday deadline to apply?
options: The student must finish the draft today.
The tutor must approve the request.
The references must be checked first.
The tutor must receive the final paper.
items.why: If the tutor approves it 指出新期限取决于教师批准。

items.stem: What deadline applies before approval?
options: The original Friday deadline
The new Tuesday deadline
The day of the request
The day the references are checked
items.why: Until you receive approval, Friday remains the deadline 表明批准前仍为周五。
